827065Executive Order 1616 — Authorizing Promotion of George E. Long to Clerk in Bureau of Insular Affairs Without Examination1912President of the United States

George E. Long may be promoted from the position of messenger to a clerkship of the lowest class in the Bureau of Insular Affairs of the War Department without examination.

Wm. H. Taft.

The White House,
